title: Instant Electric Water Heater Tap & Smart LED Temperature Display
description:
⚡ 3-Second Fast Heating: Built-in high-efficiency heating element provides warm water instantly with no waiting time.

🌡️ Digital Temperature Display: Bright LED screen displays the real-time water temperature for safe and easy monitoring.

🔄 360° Swivel Spout: Flexible 360-degree rotating pipe lets you easily wash dishes, fruits, or vegetables from any angle.

💧 Dual Hot & Cold Controls: Smooth single-lever handle allows effortless switching between hot and cold water.

🛡️ Built-in Safety Protections: Designed with hydro-electric isolation technology, anti-overheating protection, and IPX4 waterproof insulation to prevent any electrical leakage.

🛠️ Easy DIY Installation: Fits standard kitchen and bathroom sink fittings without needing complex plumbing work.
